title: The menu stops saying zero, the reference run finally has a machine that can make a part, and five buildings get a night shift

verified.the '0 alive' save, reproduced from disk: ~/.local/share/godot/app_userdata/*/saves held three real autosaves: autosave_1 'Dawn of day 4' population 0, autosave_3 'Dawn of day 3' population 0, autosave_2 'Dawn of day 2' population 18. describe_slot() rendered the first as 'Dawn of day 4 · 0 alive' and the title screen offered it under Continue. That is the critic's line, byte for byte.
verified.and the ordering bug underneath, found b: LcnSaveManager.slots() sorted with `if not is_equal_approx(ta, tb): return ta > tb` on two Unix times. is_equal_approx is RELATIVE — tolerance 1e-5 x magnitude — and a 2026 timestamp is 1.79e9, so ANY two saves written within ~17870 s (five hours) counted as simultaneous and the list fell through to sorting by slot NAME. Every autosave this game writes is inside that window: `autosave_1` was permanently 'the most recent save'. Compared as whole seconds now.
verified.the strongest form, run: old describe_slot body + old sort + `out['population'] = 0` pasted back over the new save_manager.gd, suite re-run: 4 assertions red in 3 tests, all printing '0 alive  ·  just now' and the wrong Continue slot. Restored from the copy, `git diff` clean.

handoff.[P17] game/ui/hud/vitals_widget.gd + hud: The remaining half of the '0 alive' frame, and it is one branch. `should_show()` guards has_population (missing system) but not population == 0 (a city that ended). With population 0 every derived figure collapses to a default that reads as GOOD: _draw_condition() finds no freezing/sick/hurt/unhoused/idle and prints 'warm, fed and working'; warmth01 draws BODY WARMTH 0%; food_days is huge so _food() prints 'plenty'; and city_is_cold()/city_is_freezing() both return false because they require population > 0, so the frame is severity CALM. A dead city renders as a calm, healthy one. Same rule the panel's own header already states — 'never a wall of zeroes' — applied to the zero it can compute as well as the one it cannot. LcnSaveManager.souls_words() is the shape [P24] used.
handoff.[P05] tests/citizens/test_citizen_shifts: staff_capacity 2 makes `test_the_night_trades_hold_their_requirement_after_dark` fail on its PRECONDITION — `assert_gt(thin, 0, 'at least one of them has no surplus to spare')` finds 0, because every night trade now has a spare hand, which is the point of the change. Confirmed by reverting turret_mount.tres and watchtower.tres to HEAD~1 in place: the same test passes, then fails again with them back. The suite needs to either drop that precondition or build a thin crew explicitly (a site whose staff_capacity equals its workers_required); the assertion it protects is still worth keeping.
handoff.[P09] climate ordering, one line, cosmet: Every autosave header carries `phase: deep_night` under the name 'Dawn of day N'. ClimateSystem.step() calls _roll_to_day() — which emits Bus.day_started, which the autosave runs on — BEFORE _emit_phase_change() updates _phase_idx, so anything reading climate.metrics() inside that signal gets the previous tick's phase. Not on screen anywhere today, so it is not urgent; it is one swap.
handoff.INTEGRATOR: production.stalled final 7 -> 8 against a ceiling of 6. It was already red at 7 before this wave and that band's own note says so at length. The eighth is the new workshop, stalled at t24000 for the same reason as the other seven: tick 24000 lands in the third night, discontent is 100 and every machine reads `unstaffed`. Not raised.
